newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 76,000/T January fuel oil at $149/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 76,000/T January fuel oil at $149/T.

text.p: State-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought 76,000 tonnes of low sulphur fuel oil at $149 per tonne on a cost and freight basis for January delivery, a company official said on Thursday.
The tender had sought two 38,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil for January 1-30 delivery to Kaohsiung.
The tender closed December 18 and was valid until December 20.
In its last tender, CPC purchased two 38,000-tonne cargoes of low sulphur fuel oil from Japan's Petrodiamond at $143 per tonne for delivery between January 1-20 c-and-f Kaohsiung.
